contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

dependsOn.description: Precedence/dependency edges to other operations (may be empty).

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

operationRef.description: The operation this dependency points at (its completion or its resulting proposed state is the precondition).

rationale.description: Why the dependency exists (presentation; excluded from identity).

domain.description: The vertical context of the operation — building specifics live here as DATA, never as client authority.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

extensions.description: Vertical-specific extension descriptors, carried as DATA — never interpreted, enforced or extended by a client.

kind.description: Extension kind (open vocabulary, e.g. building-element-taxonomy, assembly-compatibility-rules).

ref.description: Stable reference to the extension definition (vocabulary or ruleset id).

version.description: Semver version of the extension definition this descriptor pins.

operationVocabulary.description: Identifier of the operation-type vocabulary the solution's operations use (e.g. aise-building-operations-v1). Identifies which engine-owned catalogue the open operationType strings belong to.

vertical.description: The engineering vertical of the solution's operations (OPEN vocabulary; Phase 1 advisory value: building. Documented future verticals: civil-works, mep, industrial-equipment, electronics, integrated-circuits). Rendered verbatim by clients; vertical semantics are owned by the server solution engine.

effects.description: Engine-derived effects: proposed state transitions and quantity impacts (deterministic outputs of PROD-022; excluded from identity).

affectedNodeRefs.description: Reality nodes the effect touches (read-only references to observed reality).

items.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

direction.description: quantity-impact: whether the quantity is added, removed or changed.

geometryRefs.description: Geometry references the effect's state delta or quantity derives from.

ref.description: Stable id of the referenced geometry artifact (owned by the deterministic geometry services; read-only reference).

quantity.description: quantity-impact: the typed quantity this operation affects.

calculationRef.description: Reference to the deterministic calculation/method that produced the value (calculation provenance).

uncertainty.description: Propagated measurement uncertainty where stated; absent means 'not stated' — never zero, never fabricated.

unit.description: Explicit unit (REQUIRED — a quantity is never a bare number).

value.description: Quantity value in the stated unit.

resultingStateRef.description: state-transition: the id of the ProposedState this operation's application produces (states[N] after operation N).

operationId.description: Deterministic operation identity (deriveEngineeringOperationId): sha-256 over the canonical semantic projection — same semantics (type, parameters, target, dependencies, version context) yield the same id regardless of authoring origin.

operationIndex.description: 1-based position of this operation in its version's ordered sequence (order is semantic: it is hashed into identity and state ids).

operationType.description: The operation type (OPEN vocabulary; Phase 1 building advisory values: BUILDING_OPERATION_TYPES of the domain module).

parameters.description: The explicit typed parameters (with units) — at least one; a parameterless operation is not representable.

name.description: Parameter name (open vocabulary, lower-kebab-case; e.g. depth, width, length, thickness, height, diameter, material).

unit.description: Explicit unit for numeric values (e.g. m, mm). REQUIRED for numeric values (invariant numeric_parameter_without_unit); absent for non-numeric values.

value.description: The parameter value. Numeric values REQUIRE an explicit unit; string values carry named choices (e.g. material) without units.

provenance.description: Authoring attribution: origin (direct-manipulation | agent | imported-template), author, instant, evidence, exact agent command, compile intent reference.

authoredAt.description: Instant the intent was authored (excluded from identity derivations).

authoredBy.description: Stable reference of the author: user id, agent id or template id.

commandText.description: agent origin: the EXACT normalized natural-language command that compiled to this operation — carried verbatim, never paraphrased.

derivationNote.description: Explicit derivation/attribution statement when no evidence id applies (e.g. 'operator dimensioned the volume directly in the interactive 3D view').

evidenceIds.description: Input evidence content ids (64-hex Evidence-Graph addresses); may be empty when a derivation note or command text states the provenance.

items.description: sha-256 content address (64 lowercase hex). Normative derivation: the frozen AISE-CONTENT-V1 canonical encoding (see apps/android ContentIdentity).

intentRef.description: OPERATION RECORDS ONLY: the intent event that authored this operation (the compile provenance link of PROD-022/023).

interactionDetail.description: direct-manipulation origin: the manipulation description (e.g. 'operator dragged excavation volume handles in the 3D view').

origin.description: How the operation was authored: direct-manipulation (interactive environment), agent (natural-language command compiled to the same typed semantics) or imported-template.

rationale.description: Free-text rationale (presentation; excluded from identity derivations).

solutionId.description: The solution this operation belongs to.

target.description: The stable spatial target, anchored to observed reality through read-only references.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

description.description: Human-readable place description (e.g. 'the affected wall faces'); presentation only — excluded from identity derivations.

geometryRefs.description: Deterministic geometry references anchoring or limiting the target (drawn pit outlines, wall face polygons…).

ref.description: Stable id of the referenced geometry artifact (owned by the deterministic geometry services; read-only reference).

nodeRefs.description: Stable Reality Graph node ids the target anchors to (read-only references to observed reality).

items.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

selectorKind.description: How the target selects space: element (whole node), face-set (element faces), surface-region, volume, line-extent, point, storey or space.

units.description: Units of the spatial coordinates/anchors (carried verbatim).

angular.description: Angular unit of the target's anchors (e.g. rad).

linear.description: Linear unit of the target's anchors (e.g. m).

versionNumber.description: The solution version this operation is recorded in (version context — part of operation identity).
